entities.name: Frédéric Martens
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frédéric Vincent Martens, born Friedrich von Martens was an Italian-French photographer, engraver and inventor who spent most of his life and career in Paris. He also lived and worked in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, England and Belgium. Martens is best known for being the pioneer of panoramic-view photography.
